| Company | Revenue | EBITDA | Net income | Net debt |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| Netflix (NFLX), FY2025 | 45,183 | 13,660 | 10,981 | about 5,400 |
| Comcast (CMCSA), FY2025 | 123,707 | 36,883 | 19,998 | not found |

- **Disney revenue and net debt:** Revenue is from the FY2025 10-K (accession 0001744489-25-000155). Net debt is borrowings of 35,315 plus the current portion of 6,711, less cash of 5,695, from the Q4 earnings release (accession 0001744489-25-000154). I did not retrieve a short-term investments line for Disney.
- **Disney EBITDA:** Disney reports no operating income line, so I took revenue of 94,425 less total costs and expenses of 80,593, giving 13,832, and added D&A of 5,326. This assumes total costs include restructuring and impairment charges, which I couldn't confirm.
- **Disney net income:** This is the rounded "$12.4 billion" attributable to Disney from the annual report. Net income including non-controlling interests is 13,431.
- **Netflix:** EBITDA is operating income of 13,326.6 plus D&A of 333.4, and it excludes content amortization. Net debt uses short-term debt of 998.9 from the 10-K. Long-term debt of 13,464, cash of 9,034 and short-term investments of 29 come from a third-party summary (app.dhicapitalgroup.com/research/NFLX) and are rounded.
- **Comcast:** EBITDA is operating income of 20,672 plus depreciation of 9,327 and amortization of 6,884. Net income is the figure attributable to Comcast.

- **Comcast net debt:** I didn't retrieve its debt and cash balances.
